public_task_requirement: Please implement a website for a credit repair company to generate leads. The website should have a form-filling function, allowing users to input personal information and credit status. The website should also have a credit score inquiry function and an introduction to credit repair services. Users can browse the website, learn about credit repair services, and fill out the form to submit lead information. Set old lace as the body background and use rosy brown for the UI.

task_summary.requirement_coverage: The site targeted a credit repair lead-generation landing page with three core user-facing capabilities: a form for personal/credit-status lead capture, a credit score inquiry action, and an introduction to credit repair services, all styled with an old lace body background and rosy brown UI. Verified strengths: the credit score inquiry flow was observed to work and display a score/feedback; the color palette was judged to match the requested scheme; the page rendered without visible runtime errors. Main functional risks: the lead form was not confirmed as submitted before interaction budget exhaustion, so the confirmation state was not reached; the services/introduction content was not fully verified and was reported as not found in the interaction trace; navigation/content visibility depended on switching views, which limited confirmation of the required landing-page coverage. Visible observations: the homepage showed navigation buttons, a credit score inquiry button, and a CTA to get started, but the evaluator noted incomplete visibility of the form and service introduction in the observed screens.
verified_strengths: Credit score inquiry button produced a visible score result and qualitative feedback in evaluation.
Old lace background and rosy brown UI elements were observed as matching the requested palette.
The page rendered cleanly with no visible errors in the screenshot-based evaluation.
primary_functional_risks: Form-filling flow reached partial completion only; submission/confirmation was not observed before the interaction budget was exhausted.
Credit repair services introduction was not confirmed in the interaction trace and was reported as not visible/found during review.
The lead-generation path may be fragmented across views, making the required content harder to verify from the landing page.
The evaluator could not complete the final submit action, so end-to-end lead capture remains unconfirmed.
primary_visual_observations: The landing page showed a simple navigation bar and a prominent credit score inquiry button.
The screenshot-based evaluator reported low text contrast for the main heading against the background.
The first screen did not visibly present the full form-filling function or a clear services introduction, according to the appearance review.
The overall layout was clean but sparse, with limited visible content density on the initial screen.

appearance_reflection.observed_result: The homepage heading is exactly "Welcome to Credit Repair Experts." The page uses white text on a rosybrown navigation bar, and the home cards use white backgrounds with black text. The reviewer still found the heading-to-background contrast very low and said the typography is minimal, so the first screen does not make the main heading easy to read.
appearance_reflection.likely_cause_or_limitation: Appearance issue on the first screen: the heading and surrounding text need stronger contrast and weight to be readable up front.
appearance_reflection.preventative_action: Make the main heading and any hero text use a clearly readable contrast against the page background, and give the primary text a stronger weight or size so it is legible at a glance. Verify that the first screen’s headline can be read without strain and that the typography is visibly stronger than body text.
appearance_reflection.verification: Render the first screen and check that the main heading is readable immediately, with clear contrast against its background and a visibly stronger font weight than surrounding copy.
appearance_reflection.transfer_limits: Applies to lead-generation landing pages and other single-page marketing sites with a prominent hero heading and short supporting copy.
